verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents first-party integrations for all three named frameworks: a native LangChain Python/JS integration, a `wrap_openai` wrapper for the OpenAI SDK, and a listed Vercel AI SDK integration, along with general framework-integration and OpenTelemetry paths. Community comments corroborate that LangChain tracing is turnkey, though one report says other frameworks such as CrewAI work poorly. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Vercel AI SDK integration beyond a listing mention, independent hands-on corroboration of the OpenAI SDK and Vercel AI SDK integrations.

support.subject: As a developer, I can instrument my app through existing integrations for frameworks like LangChain, the OpenAI SDK, or the Vercel AI SDK

citations.quote: It works with any LLM Application, including a native integration with the LangChain Python and LangChain JS open source libraries.
Browse available integrations to connect your stack including OpenAI, Anthropic, CrewAI, Vercel AI SDK, Pydantic AI, and more.
Add tracing to your app in minutes with environment variables, framework integrations, or the SDK.
